<h>Lectio 1</h>
De libro Apocalýpsis beáti Ioánnis Apóstoli
<r>Apo 2:18-20</r>
<n>18</n> Ángelo Thyatíræ Ecclésiæ scribe: Hæc dicit Fílius Dei, qui habet óculos tamquam flammam ignis, et pedes eius símiles aurichálco:
<n>19</n> Novi ópera tua, et fidem, et caritátem tuam, et ministérium, et patiéntiam tuam, et ópera tua novíssima plura prióribus.
<n>20</n> Sed hábeo advérsus te pauca: quia permíttis mulíerem Iézabel, quæ se dicit prophéten, docére, et sedúcere servos meos, fornicári, et manducáre de idolóthytis.

<r>℣.</r> Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
<r>℟.</r> Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
<c>O</c>rémus.
<c>P</c>ræsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut qui paschália festa perégimus, hæc, te largiénte, móribus et vita teneámus.
<h>P</h>er Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

b.e5577cb863:
<h>Prayer</h>
<r>℣.</r> O Lord, hear my prayer.
<r>℟.</r> And let my cry come unto thee.
<c>L</c>et us pray.
<c>G</c>rant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that we who have celebrated the Paschal Feast, may, by Thy bounty, retain its fruits in our daily habits and behaviour.
<h>T</h>hrough Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.

b.57cbc1445b:
<h>Martyrologium</h>
<c>S</c>exto Idus Aprílis Luna secúnda. Anno Dómini 2027
<h>C</h>ommemorátio sanctórum Herodiónis, Asýncriti et Phlegóntis, de quibus scribit beátus Paulus Apóstolus in Epístola ad Romános.
<h>A</h>lexandríæ sancti Ædésii Mártyris, qui, sub Maximiáno Galério Imperatóre, cum esset beáti Apphiáni frater, et ímpium Iúdicem, quod Deo dicátas Vírgines leónibus tráderet, palam argúeret, idcírco, a milítibus tentus sævissimísque afféctus supplíciis, in mare demérsus est pro Christo Dómino.
<h>I</h>n Africa sanctórum Mártyrum Ianuárii, Máximæ et Macáriæ.
<h>C</h>arthágine sanctæ Concéssæ Mártyris.
<h>A</h>pud Corínthum beáti Dionýsii Epíscopi, qui eruditióne et grátia, quam hábuit in verbo Dei, non solum suæ civitátis et provínciæ pópulos, sed et aliárum provínciarum et úrbium Epíscopos epístolis erudívit; Romanósque Pontífices ádeo cóluit, ut eórum epístolas públice légere in Ecclésia diébus Domínicis consuevérit. Cláruit autem tempóribus Marci Antoníni Veri et Lúcii Aurélii Cómmodi.
<h>T</h>urónis, in Gállia, sancti Perpétui Epíscopi, admirándæ sanctitátis viri.
<h>F</h>erentíni, in Hérnicis, sancti Redémpti Epíscopi, cuius méminit beátus Gregórius Papa.
<h>A</h>pud Comum sancti Amántii, Epíscopi et Confessóris.
<r>℣.</r> Et álibi aliórum plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum et Confessórum, atque sanctárum Vírginum.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.
b.6fb72efcd8:
<h>Martyrology</h>
<c>A</c>pril 8th 2027, the 2nd day of the Moon, were born into the better life:
<h>O</h>n the same day are commemorated holy Herodion, Asyncritus, and Phlegon, concerning whom the blessed Apostle Paul writeth in his Epistle unto the Romans.
<h>A</h>t Alexandria, the holy martyr Edesius, brother of the blessed Apphian. Under the Emperor Maximian Galerius he openly rebuked the wicked judge for condemning to the lions the virgins vowed to God, wherefore he was apprehended by the soldiers, put to most cruel torments, and drowned in the sea, for the Lord Christ's sake.
<h>I</h>n Africa, the holy martyrs Januarius, Maxima, and Macaria.
<h>A</h>t Carthage, the holy martyr Concessa.
<h>A</h>t Corinth, blessed Denis, Bishop of that city, who by the learning and grace which he had in the Word of God, taught by his epistles not only the people of his own city and province but also the bishops of other provinces and cities, and who had such a veneration for the Popes of Rome that he was used to have their Epistles publicly read in the Church upon the Lord's Day. He flourished in the times of the Emperors Marcus Antoninus Verus and Lucius Aurelius Commodus.
<h>A</h>t Tours, [in the year 494,] holy Perpetuus, Bishop of that see, a man of wonderful holiness.
<h>A</h>t Fiorentino, in Campania, holy Redemptus, [in the year 586,] Bishop of that see, of whom mention is made by blessed Pope Gregory.
<h>A</h>t Como, the holy Confessor Amantius, Bishop of that see, [about the year 446.]
<r>℣.</r> And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.

b.ebdc957211:
<h>Oratio</h>
<r>℣.</r> Dóminus vobíscum.
<r>℟.</r> Et cum spíritu tuo.
<c>O</c>rémus.
<c>P</c>ræsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut qui paschália festa perégimus, hæc, te largiénte, móribus et vita teneámus.
<h>P</h>er Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.
b.d23df9fc67:
<h>Prayer</h>
<r>℣.</r> The Lord be with you.
<r>℟.</r> And with thy spirit.
<c>L</c>et us pray.
<c>G</c>rant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that we who have celebrated the Paschal Feast, may, by Thy bounty, retain its fruits in our daily habits and behaviour.
<h>T</h>hrough Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.
